issues.description: Aufgabe 02 (SQL query): The problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires a single numeric result reporting how many Gemeinden are in the Regierungsbezirk 'Oberbayern' (an aggregated COUNT). The provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql) instead returns all Gemeinde rows for 'Oberbayern' (SELECT * ... WHERE regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern'), i.e. multiple rows and full columns rather than one aggregated scalar. This mismatch between the expected result shape (one count value) and the solution's result shape (many rows) will cause automatic equivalence checks to fail and confuse students about the required aggregation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution query to return a single aggregated count. Example correction: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gemeinde WHERE regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern'; Optionally update the template (aufgabe02.sql) to hint at aggregation (e.g. include the SELECT COUNT(*) structure) so students implement the expected single-value result shape.
